request.prompt:
To plan this sprint I need the project intake. Please provide:
1. a product overview , the framing + goals the features are proposed from (`product-overview.md`)
2. the non-functional requirements (NFRs) the work must satisfy (`nfrs.md`)
3. a design brief , the UX/visual direction for the SPA (`design/design-brief.md`)
4. any brand asset(s) (logo/icon) to carry into the design (`design/assets/warehouse.png`)

Place each under the project's `.consort/`; I will read them as the proposal + design inputs.
